remarks: Chic, sunny, spacious corner unit is the perfect combo of vibrant urban lifestyle and a comfortable home boasting soaring 13-foot ceilings, hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light pouring in through oversized windows. Located on the top floor in a secure, 12-unit elevator building on a charming, quiet street in the heart of bustling SoNo. The open-concept living and dining room floor plan is ideal for both entertaining and everyday living, complete with a home office alcove. A cook's kitchen features gas range, granite countertops, ample cabinetry, stainless steel appliances. Gorgeous bedroom with dramatic 13 ft. high ceilings, large windows, closets galore. A large 289 sq.ft. Loft area levels up this home's functionality for hosting guests or storing belongings. Practical design touches include a bright, updated bathroom with lighted mirror, entry area with bench/shoe storage, in-unit washer/dryer, central A/C and energy-efficient gas heating. Well-maintained, safe, pet-friendly building with garden, picnic tables, assigned indoor garage parking, guest parking, lower level laundry room. Just steps to world-class dining, S. Norwalk Metro North train station, the SoNo Collection Mall, Maritime Aquarium, Oyster Shell Park, art galleries and the harbor, this location offers the perfect balance of urban energy and relaxed coastal living. It's more than a place to live - it's a lifestyle!
